targets.rawSql: WITH trial_metrics AS (SELECT t.id AS trial_index, t.time_created, m.value AS metric_name, mv.value AS metric_value FROM trial_v2 t JOIN data_v2 d ON (d.data_json::jsonb -> 'trial_index' ->> '0')::int = t.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(d.data_json::jsonb -> 'metric_name') AS m(key, value) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(d.data_json::jsonb -> 'mean') AS mv(key, value) WHERE m.key = mv.key) SELECT to_timestamp(time_created) AS time, metric_name, metric_value::float AS value FROM trial_metrics WHERE metric_name IN ('j_real', 'j_physics') ORDER BY time

WITH trial_metrics AS (SELECT t.id AS candidate_id, t.time_created, m.value AS metric_name, mv.value AS metric_value FROM trial_v2 t JOIN data_v2 d ON (d.data_json::jsonb -> 'trial_index' ->> '0')::int = t.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(d.data_json::jsonb -> 'metric_name') AS m(key, value) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(d.data_json::jsonb -> 'mean') AS mv(key, value) WHERE m.key = mv.key) SELECT candidate_id, to_timestamp(time_created) AS created, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'j_physics' THEN metric_value::float END) AS j_physics, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'j_real' THEN metric_value::float END) AS j_real, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'j_residual' THEN metric_value::float END) AS residual FROM trial_metrics GROUP BY candidate_id, time_created ORDER BY candidate_id DESC LIMIT 50
